_comment: LEAN mission spec. Copy to specs/M-0NN.json (drop the .example) and fill for a real candidate. The runner: rechecks the issue -> clones at base_commit -> Codex codes from code_prompt -> verify+build receipt locally. It STOPS before any push/fork/PR. Values below are the real M-009 prettier mission, shown as a worked example.
code_prompt: Markdown formatting is not idempotent for an escaped semicolon guarding an HTML entity in a link URL: `[test](/hello?foo&quot\;bar)` loses its backslash on the second pass and resolves as an entity. Preserve the escaped form so formatting is idempotent. Add a regression fixture under tests/format/markdown and a changelog_unreleased entry per CONTRIBUTING.

repo_policy_snapshot.ai_policy_summary: No CLA or DCO required (MIT). CONTRIBUTING requires updating Jest snapshots and adding a changelog_unreleased entry. CI: yarn test (multiple Node), yarn lint (ESLint, TS typecheck, prettier self-check, changelog lint).

limitations: Contributor self-run record of Northset's own contribution; not the maintainer's verification.
The declared network-off check runs Prettier's Markdown Jest suite on Node 22 via the vendored Yarn, after a disclosed online phase-A install. It does not run the full repo test/lint matrix.
